document.title: Docs match the code, with less repeated text
document.summary: Fixes doc claims the code contradicts, cuts repeated docs, allows two questions, and drops two skills.
document.why: [The owner](source:s1) asks to check every markdown file for correctness and to delete redundant, tautological documentation.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Nov 15
sources.gist: Markdown audit with a council; owner picks two questions and drops both skills.

parts.name: Doc fixes
parts.summary: Docs say what the code does, once.

parts.name: Questions cap
parts.summary: The skill allows two questions, like the schema.

parts.name: Unused skills
parts.summary: Two vendored skills that nothing uses are gone.

groups.title: Claims the code contradicts
groups.summary: Each edited sentence now matches the code it names, such as `defaultBaseRef` trying `trunk` and the eval exit rule in `checks.ts`.

fileNotes.README.md: Adds `trunk`; marks `--base`/`--head` optional; full validate checks.
fileNotes..cursor/BUGBOT.md: Exit-code rule and `setup-vp` as the npm source.
fileNotes..github/workflows/eval.yml: Comment: a failed login check keeps the subscription.
fileNotes.docs/glossary.md: Skill reads git; refs come from `pregroup`; typo fixed.
fileNotes.AGENTS.md: How it works describes `pregroup`; grep also covers `*.md`.
fileNotes.docs/eval.md: Producer failure and three fixed checks also fail a case.

groups.title: Repeated text cut
groups.summary: Text that repeated another doc or a file listing now points at the one place that owns it.

fileNotes.CONTRIBUTING.md: Refresh bullets go; points at glossary and `refresh.md`.
fileNotes.AGENTS.md: Drops per-file lists and Muse login steps; links `docs/eval.md`.
fileNotes.docs/eval.md: Ember contributor-mode rule now stated once, in Muse setup.
fileNotes.docs/glossary.md: Deletes the Group entry, which said nothing.

groups.title: Two questions per group
groups.summary: The skill now allows at most two questions per group, which `review.ts` already accepts. The `.agents` file is the synced copy.

fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md: Field list and Questions section say two, not one.
